objectClass.notes: Single-view stylized reconstruction; front/three-quarter features are observed and rear surfaces are inferred.

reasoning: The character combines an interrupted organic silhouette, 10 required runtime nodes, paired articulated limbs, a swept spiral tail, dense scales, mottled color fields, and high-sensitivity face features.
The two eye assemblies and neck/head separation require a deeper hierarchy than a static figurine.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Silhouette and interaction depend on nested pivots while likeness depends on repeated scales, crest plates, color patches, and eye layers.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Rear torso scale/color pattern is hidden and will use a symmetric palette continuation.
The rear surface and exact depth of the casque are inferred from chameleon anatomy and the visible three-quarter projection.
Occluded digit arrangement is inferred from the visible hands and feet.

details.description: gold-green iris, black pupil and white catchlight
high sloped peaked casque with ochre edge plates
larger plate scales across snout and mouth margin
thin russet nearly horizontal mouth crease
single visible recessed nostril with rust rim
small triangular spines descending from neck toward tail
irregular turquoise and ochre skin patches
muted ochre bands along thick spiral tail
broad splayed three-lobed feet with pale tips

anatomy.note: Ratios measured approximately from the admitted three-quarter reference; depth and rear anatomy have lower confidence.

definitionOfDone: At the matched hero view the render must immediately read as the same mint-green stylized chameleon through its peaked head, enormous turret eyes, compact upright proportions, long splayed limbs, and spiral tail.
The named runtime hierarchy and independent head, eyes, jaw, and tail pivots must exist and be discoverable by name.
Front, profile, and rear-three-quarter views must show attached non-degenerate volumes without floating limbs, broken tail continuity, or hollow head artifacts.

featureGroups.name: Chameleon silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: 3.1–3.4 head-unit height, head wider than upper torso, pear torso, splayed stance, continuous spiral tail
failureModes: tail reads as a ring or straight cone

featureGroups.name: Independent protruding eye assemblies
qualityCriteria: two symmetric turret sockets, separately rotatable pivots, layered iris/pupil/catchlight, strong protrusion

featureGroups.name: Casque, muzzle and jaw
qualityCriteria: peaked sloped casque, broad flat muzzle, tucked jaw and thin straight mouth crease

featureGroups.name: Scaled mottled skin
qualityCriteria: mint/teal/yellow-green palette, shallow scale relief, larger facial plates and irregular localized patches

featureGroups.name: Limb, digit and tail attachments
qualityCriteria: all appendage roots overlap parents, digits connect to palms/soles, tail continuously leaves pelvis

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge eye pivots with the head mesh.
Do not represent the spiral tail as a torus.
Do not flatten digits into a texture.
Do not pass a view with disconnected appendages or a generic spherical head.

authoringInstruction: Use this observed complex character contract to author the procedural model and review each locked pass.
